blocks.text:
After breakfast, ride to Paraty along the Costa Verde coastal highway, with views of the ocean, mountains and green hillsides along the way.

**Approximate distance:** 350 km.  
**Hotel:** Pousada Corsário.

Paraty has preserved a large collection of 18th-century Portuguese colonial buildings. In the late 1700s, gold from Minas Gerais passed through the town on its way to Portugal. The main route later shifted to Rio, helping Paraty retain its historic buildings. UNESCO recognised the town for its important colonial architecture. Paraty is a small seaside town where historic streets meet the tropical coast. Here the motorcycle itinerary takes another break from the road for time on foot and on the water.

In the evening, take a three-hour tour of the historic centre.
Colourful doors of old houses reflected in water on a cobbled street in Paraty, Brazil
Paraty: bright façades and their reflections on a quiet street

After breakfast, take a boat trip with stops at beaches and islands in the bay. Look out over emerald waters and small islands. You may spot dolphins, large fish and sea turtles in the area.

You can swim during the stops if you wish. The boat trip takes up most of the day and shows you Paraty from the water. After yesterday evening's walk through the colonial centre, the shoreline, islands and green hillsides set the scene.
